codePrerequisites.note: The mask bits are inferred from the 0x4A1818 panel pointer order (HQ, granary, wood, weapon, money, infantry, archer, cavalry, chariot). The docs/remake table says cavalry <- weapon; the original page-1 mask instead gates cavalry on granary+wood, while weapon is used by the second (building-side) menu mask. Treat the per-entry mapping as high-confidence, not yet screenshot-verified.

buildMenu.note: Original build command range 0x3F16..0x3F30 covers all 27 types; types 21/22/24/25 have no build icon. The remake restricts the player list to 10 categories; the original worker menu 0x111DE shows 9 categories (including 车兵所) and a second building-side menu 0x11210 uses the other mask.
